summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by Stone Point Credit Income Fund to disclose a regular monthly distribution of $0.22 per share declared by its Board of Trustees for May 2026, payable on June 20, 2026, to shareholders of record on May 31, 2026. The distribution can be received in cash or reinvested under the fund's distribution reinvestment plan. No special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. The filing is an ordinary course event for a closed-end fund, with no strategic or transactional elements warranting classification as a special situation.
